thread:
maria: Quick plan kickoff 12: we need a short "warmth" drip ahead of the benchmark webinar in two weeks. Goal: increase registered attendees from recent active subs. Need lanes (high/med/low), 12 sends each, owners, and test plan.

jon: thumbs up. Suggest lanes: High (recent open/click) = invite + social proof; Medium = teaser + invite; Low = educational nudge (no hard ask).

sam: Ops: we'll A/B subject lines and stagger by timezone. Also add suppression for already-registered. Triggers: open 014d, 1560d, >60d.

lee: Proposed segments:
- High: opened/clicked <=14d or visited /benchmarks
- Medium: opened 1560d or engaged with docs
- Low: no opens 61180d
I'll share SQL for each.

olivia: I'll own copy. Voice = concise, product-first, one CTA. Will provide 3 subjects + 2 preview lines per lane by Mon.

sam: SQL sample for High for ops: ```sql
SELECT id FROM subscribers WHERE (last_opened >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 14 DAY) OR last_clicked >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AND unsubscribed = false AND registered_for_webinar = false;```

jon: Routing: register -> tag `bench-web-2025`, push to CRM as MQL. No-register after 2 sends -> move to evergreen benchmark nurture. UTM: utm_campaign=bench-webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter.

maria: Send cadence: High = send + reminder 48h; Medium = send + follow in 5 days; Low = single nudge then monthly newsletter. Windows: Tue/Thu 10am local for High/Medium, Low Fri 11am local.

olivia: Draft subjects (first pass):
High: A) "See how X cut inference time 6x 12 join our benchmark webinar" B) "Live: benchmark results + Q&A" C) "Benchmark: real-world inference wins" Preview: "Short demo + concrete numbers."
Medium: A) "Benchmark highlights 12 what matters" B) "Worth 20 minutes: latency vs cost" C) "Sneak peek 12 key takeaways" Preview: "Quick read + invite."
Low: A) "Beginner's guide to inference cost" B) "How to get predictable latency" C) "Benchmarks, simplified" Preview: "Practical steps, no fluff."

lee: For A/B, hold out 10% for 48h, then send winner. Agree on subject+preview split test.

sam: Automation checklist: build segments in Customer.io, create HTML/plain templates, Litmus QA, suppression lists, track conversions on CTA, seed list tests.

maria: Owners: Olivia = copy + drafts Mon 9am PT; Sam = segment build + schedule; Jon = routing & CRM mapping; Lee = SQL review; I'll do final QA and send sign-off.

olivia: Delivering drafts Mon 9am PT. Will include alt subjects & preview lines.

jon: I'll share lead routing sheet Tue noon.

sam: Templates + segment builds started today, QA ready Wed.

maria: One more: High lane needs 3 bullet metric highlights (measurable only). Sam/Lee can you confirm top 3 metrics to surface?

lee: Tentative: P95 latency reduction, tokens/sec improvement, per-token cost delta vs baseline. Will confirm with infra EOD.

sam: Can export visuals from benchmark dashboard for landing page.

maria: Great. I'll create an Asana checklist and tag owners. Keep updates in-thread. :white_check_mark:
